Motion by: Deputy Mayor Healey Seconded by: Trustee Schriner Record of Vote: Board Member Aye Nay Abstained Absent Mayor Peeler X Deputy Mayor Healey X Trustee Sprague X Trustee Schriner X Resolution Adopted: Yes No Resolution # 3-2026 A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE POLLING PLACE FOR THE 2026 VILLAGE ELECTION WHEREAS, the Village Board of Trustees previously adopted a resolution, Resolution #52-2025, designating Wednesday, March 18, 2026, as Village Election Day, establishing polling hours from 12:00 noon to 9:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time, and designating the polling place as the Village Municipal Building, 8 East Main Street, Fonda, New York; and WHEREAS, the Village of Fonda’s elections are conducted by the Montgomery County Board of Elections in accordance with New York State Election Law; and WHEREAS, following consultation with the Montgomery County Board of Elections Commissioner, it has been determined that relocating the polling place to the Montgomery County Board of Elections would reduce election -related costs, including but not limited to voting machine delivery, programming, and inspector expenses; and WHEREAS, holding the election at the Board of Elections will consolidate election operations at a single, fully equipped location and promote administrative efficiency; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Village Board of Trustees of the Village of Fonda hereby amends the previously adopted election resolution #52-2025, solely with respect to the polling place; and

Board of Trustees Minutes Date: 4 BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that the polling place for the March 18, 2026, Village Election is hereby designated as the Montgomery County Board of Elections, 9 Park Street, Fonda, New York; and BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that all other provisions of the prior resolution, including the election date of Wednesday, March 18, 2026, and polling hours of 12:00 noon to 9:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time, shall remain in full force and effect; and BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that Christine Kearns, Village Clerk, is hereby directed to transmit a certified copy of this resolution to the Montgomery County Board of Elections and to take such further actions as may be required by law. Approved and adopted by the Village Board of Trustees of the Village of Fonda, Montgomery County, New York, this 12th day of January 2026. Motion by: Deputy Mayor Healey Seconded by: Trustee Schriner Record of Vote: Board Member Aye Nay Abstained Absent Mayor Peeler X Deputy Mayor Healey X Trustee Sprague X Trustee Schriner X Resolution Adopted: Yes No RESOLUTION #4-2026 AMENDING THE EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK WHEREAS, the Village Board periodically reviews and updates the Employee Handbook to ensure clarity and consistency in benefits administration; and WHEREAS, the Village seeks to clarify holiday pay provisions for full-time non-exempt employees required to work on designated holidays; and WHEREAS, the Village also seeks to provide guidance regarding health insurance continuation for eligible retirees in a manner consistent with general municipal practice and the provisions offered by the Village’s insurance provider; NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Employee Handbook is hereby amended as follows: Holidays – Clarification of Holiday Pay for Non-Exempt Employees Regular full-time employees are entitled to the holidays listed in the Employee Handbook. Other days or parts of days may be designated as holidays with or without pay. No holiday pay will be paid to an employee who is on an unpaid status, on any leave, or absent due to workers' compensation. If a holiday falls on a Sunday, the holiday may be observed on the following Monday. If the holiday falls on a Saturday, the holiday may be observed on the preceding Friday. Employees may schedule vacation time adjacent to a paid holiday; however, holiday pay and vacation pay cannot be claimed for the same day. If a holiday falls during an approved vacation period, the day will be treated as a holiday, not as a vacation day, and will not reduce the employee’s vacation balance. Full-time non-exempt employees who are required to work on a designated holiday will be compensated at one and one- half (1.5) times their regular hourly rate for all hours worked on the holiday, in addition to any holiday pay they are eligi ble to receive. To qualify for holiday pay, the employee must work their scheduled shifts and must not have used a sick day within one (1) scheduled work day prior to or after the holiday. Continuation of Benefits – Extended Continuation for Retirees Retired employees who have completed ten (10) or more years of service with the Village are eligible to continue participation in the group health insurance plan beyond the standard COBRA period, provided they assume full responsibility for the cost of premiums. This continuation is not subject to COBRA time limitations and will remain available as long as premiums are paid in full and on time. Coverage will mirror the active employee plan, including options for dependent coverage. Retirees must notify the Village Clerk in writing within thirty (30) days of retirement to elect this extended continuation and will receive monthly billing statements. Failure to remit payment by the due date may result in termination of coverage.

Board of Trustees Minutes Date: 5 This amendment replaces any prior policy or provision regarding Village contributions toward retiree health insurance costs for individuals continuing coverage after retirement. Under this amendment, retirees electing extended continuation shall assume full responsibility for all premiums. BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that these amendments shall take effect immediately and be incorporated into all future editions of the Employee Handbook. Approved and adopted by the Village Board of Trustees of the Village of Fonda, Montgomery County, New York, this 12th day of January 2026.
